_comment: How many of the largest items it takes to reach 80% of spending. Run by BOTH backend/tests/unit/test_domain_concentration.py (payee mode: the server serves the count, because it ranks every payee and sends only the top 25) and frontend/src/components/reports/charts/paretoData.test.ts (category and group modes, which the client holds in full). Totals are listed largest first; `items_to_80` is null when nothing was spent.
